3. poly_monomial → FFT_{8192} → data_fr (evaluations at 8192 roots of unity)

- poly_monomial has degree < 4096 (by construction)
- FFT_{8192}(poly_monomial) produces evaluations at 8192 roots of unity
- IFFT_{8192}(those evaluations) recovers the unique polynomial of degree < 8192 with those evaluations
- But since the polynomial actually has degree < 4096, coefficients 4096..8191 will be zero
